show.description: A tale of love, betrayal, and redemption. Sara returns years after leaving Naman, only to find him a ruthless billionaire bent on revenge. As hidden truths unfold, Naman realizes her sacrifice, while Gaurav’s silent love heals Sara. In the end, some loves break you, while others mend your heart.
